---
# ocp4_workload_edge_mirror: log in to the edge mirror registry, then copy the
# release images that the edge-mirror-lab devices pull.

- name: Log in to the edge mirror registry
  vars:
    edge_mirror_registry_basic_auth: <REDACTED>
  ansible.builtin.command:
    cmd: >-
      oc registry login
      --registry={{ edge_mirror_registry_host }}
      --auth-basic={{ edge_mirror_registry_basic_auth }}
      --to={{ edge_mirror_auth_file }}
  changed_when: true

- name: Mirror the release images
  ansible.builtin.command:
    cmd: >-
      oc image mirror --keep-manifest-list=true
      --registry-config={{ edge_mirror_auth_file }}
      {{ edge_mirror_source_image }}
      {{ edge_mirror_registry_host }}/{{ edge_mirror_target_repo }}
  changed_when: true
